AP eq (22) recurses on m (number of variables): fixes color x_m, decomposes by which subset of path vertices gets color m (compositions alpha with |alpha|=r or n), reducing to X_{P_{alpha_i-1}}(x_{m-1}) and X_{P_{n-r}}(x_{m-1}).
